errors.evidence: The description does not state the overall topic of the chart, which is the perceived strengths of women entrepreneurs, as indicated by the figure's original caption.
The categories on the x-axis are not sorted in alphabetical order. They are sorted in descending order based on the value of the bars.

errors.text_span: достига приблизително 60% от максималната стойност на скалата
errors.evidence: This phrasing is mathematically incorrect. The bar for "по-добри комуникатори" represents a value of approximately 59% on the scale itself. Stating it reaches "60% of the maximum value of the scale" would mean 60% of 70%, which is 42%, a completely different and incorrect value.
The bar for the category "консервативни към риска" reaches approximately 16%, not 13%. The stated value is a significant deviation from the visual evidence.
